_: PLACEHOLDER — the real price sheet has not been sent yet (WW-115).
_source: Derived from the one SKU in 'inventory for distribution - Dropdown.csv' (MKU003). That export's cost column is a #N/A VLOOKUP into a sheet that was never exported, so these unit prices are line_cost / quantity: 16 for 20 balloons = 80 paise each, 4 for 2 confetti = 200, 8 for 2 curtains = 400. Enough to build and test against, not enough to price a real kit.
_names: Names are copied VERBATIM from that export, misspellings included (MATALIC, CONFETI, MATTALIC, 'Glue dote stripe'). That is deliberate, not laziness: PROMPT-inventory.md hands this list to the AI and asks for these exact strings back, so the name here and the name in the reply are one key. Cleaning a name is fine — it just has to be cleaned here, where the prompt reads it from. Never in one place only.
_missing: Banner has no price anywhere in that export, so it is absent rather than zero. A kit containing it shows 'no price' on that line and says the total is short — which is the truth.
_paise: Cost of ONE unit, in integer paise. Money never lives in this repo as a float.
